results.title: Pakistan government to challenge Imran Khan hospital move, says law minister
results.description: ISLAMABAD, Aug 19 - Pakistan's government will challenge a Supreme Court decision that ordered authorities to move jailed former Prime Minister Imran Khan to a private hospital, Law Minister Azam Nazeer Tarar said in a video statement.

results.title: Chief of Staff finds new role for offcier blocked from promotion
results.description: Defense Minister Israel Katz rejected a promotion for Maj. Gen. Eliad Muati. Now, IDF Chief of Staff Eyal Zamir has found a way to keep the senior officer in service.
